title: PMJAY–MJPJAY Integrated Scheme – Maharashtra Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Integrated government health assurance arrangement combining PM-JAY and Maharashtra's state health assurance programme.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows the applicable PM-JAY and Maharashtra beneficiary rules; some categories are covered through state-specific pathways.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under PMJAY–MJPJAY Integrated Scheme – Maharashtra.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
